data.title: Nvidia customers notified about AI-related price hikes above 15%

data.title: NVK Vulkan Video Merged For Mesa 26.3
data.summary: The NVK Vulkan driver in Mesa has received initial support for Vulkan Video, specifically H.264 decoding, which has been merged into Mesa 26.3-devel. This new feature required significant reverse engineering and Rust programming implementation, and currently only supports Turing and newer NVIDIA GPUs due to reliance on the NVIDIA GSP. The full NVK Vulkan Video support, including H.264, is expected to debut in Mesa 26.3, set for a stable release in Q4, coinciding with the Linux 7.3 kernel which provides the necessary Nouveau patch.
